decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing builds on the firm's existing drainage and customizable manufacturing knowledge, allowing it to interpret results and improve the product.
This floor-level shower drainage system is at the core of the firm's proven drainage technology and product families, so it is highly likely to be kept.
The designer shower drainage product extends the firm's core drainage know-how with design expertise, making it easy to assimilate feedback and improve.
The shower element with integrated slope is adjacent to the firm's floor-level shower and installation solutions, so related knowledge supports learning and improvement.
The backflow-protected basement floor drain uses the firm's drainage know-how and adds backflow protection, a close extension that management can understand and refine.
The air-admittance valve lies outside the firm's core drainage and shower installation knowledge, so the firm lacks the related knowledge to interpret early results and is more likely to drop it.
